dct_description_sm: On January 1st, 2016 a new law that applies to pedestrian crossovers was introduced as part of Bill 31: Making Ontario's Roads Safer Act. The law provides municipal road authorities the ability to install pedestrian crossovers on low speed, low volume roads. On May 3rd, 2016 Municipal Council approved the implementation of a Pedestrian Crossover Program.  This layer tracks designated pedestrian crossover locations.
